units.source_text: 藤壶皇后写给源氏大将的信，所谈的只是一般的事情，

en.t: The letter that Empress Fujitsubo wrote to General Genji spoke only of ordinary matters,

units.source_text: 以及关于皇太子有所请托之事，是严正的答谢信。

en.t: and of her request concerning the Crown Prince; it was a formal letter of thanks.

units.source_text: 源氏大将看了，想道：“她如此小心，多么顽强！”

en.t: When General Genji read it, he thought, "She is so cautious, and so stubborn!"
He could not help feeling resentful in his heart.

units.source_text: 然而回想自己过去对皇太子照顾无微不至，

en.t: Yet when he remembered how carefully he had looked after the Crown Prince in the past,

units.source_text: 如今倘使忽然疏远，深恐外人怀疑，怪他变心。

en.t: he feared that if he suddenly became distant now, others would grow suspicious and blame him for a change of heart.

units.source_text: 便在藤壶皇后出宫之日进宫去探望皇太子。

en.t: So on the day Empress Fujitsubo left the palace, he went there to visit the Crown Prince.
